# Datasheet for Datasets (v0.1)

PhD in Deep Tech · UNMSM · Session 7 · Edgar Aldair Quispe Huaman · Format: Gebru et al. (2021)

**Dataset:** Synthetic underground LHD fleet telemetry, generated by `src/simulator.py` with `configs/pilot.yaml`.

## Motivation

Created to evaluate the digital twin agents under controlled degradation, duty cycles and intermittent connectivity while access to real mining telemetry is negotiated. Because ground-truth health is known at every hour, it allows the fidelity of the twin to be measured directly.

## Composition

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Instance | One hourly observation of one loader |
| Fleet | 10 units |
| Horizon | 2,160 hours (90 days) per replication |
| Replications | 30, seeds 1000–1029 |
| Channels | Engine temperature (°C), hydraulic pressure (bar), vibration RMS (mm/s), oil temperature (°C), fuel rate (L/h) |
| Latent variables | Health index in [0, 1], duty cycle, connectivity flag |
| Personal data | None |

## Collection Process

Data are generated, not collected. Health degrades through gamma-distributed hourly increments (mean life 700 h, shape 2) scaled by duty cycle and by a unit-level lognormal heterogeneity factor (σ = 0.2). Each channel is the sum of a base value, a duty-cycle effect, a degradation effect proportional to the squared wear and Gaussian noise. An observation reaches the twin only when the unit is connected (probability 0.6 per hour).

## Preprocessing

None. The diagnosis agent learns its healthy baseline from the first 168 hours of each replication.

## Uses

- **Use in this project:** artificial, formative evaluation of the twin agents and the maintenance policies.
- **Limitation:** the sensor model and degradation process are assumptions of the author; they must be calibrated against public run-to-failure data and validated with real telemetry before supporting claims about real equipment.

## Distribution and Maintenance

Fully reproducible from the code and configuration in this repository; any change to the generator is versioned through the configuration file and the git commit logged with each run.

## Legal Compliance (Peru)

Contains no personal data within the scope of Law N° 29733.
